title: pvAppendDatasets
body:
## pvAppendDatasets

Merges the meshes of several datasets into one. With OutputDataSetType Unstructured Grid (ParaView default) inputs of almost any type are appended; with Polygonal Mesh only polydata inputs are merged and the rest are left out. Only point and cell arrays present on every input are kept, and coincident points are not merged. Use it to combine separate nodes, e.g. two clipped regions; append is the curated equivalent, pvAppendGeometry keeps polydata, and merge or pvMergeBlocks flatten one composite input.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Composite (multiblock) inputs are not accepted; flatten them with merge first.
- Arrays missing from any one input are dropped; make names agree, e.g. with pvRenameArrays.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AppendDatasets`. Identity: `filters/Append`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. ParaView: This property specifies the datasets to be merged into a single dataset by the Append Datasets filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OutputDataSetType` | Determines the output type produced by this filter. Only input datasets compatible with the output type will be merged in the output. For example, if the output type is "Polygonal Mesh", then inputs of type "Image Data", "StructuredGrid", etc. will not be merged. On the other hand, if the output type is "Unstructured Grid", then inputs of almost any type will be merged in the output. Defaults to "Unstructured Grid". | `{"type":"enum","values":["Polygonal Mesh","Unstructured Grid"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Polygonal Mesh"` |

```json
  "mode": "serial",
```

```json
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAppendDatasets",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": [
      "UPSTREAM_Input"
    ]
  }
}
```
